name: Don't touch the cat!
source:
You are Adrian, and this is your first day at work!

The only thing you have to do is to take care of this cat for 5 minutes until her owners come back! It's not that difficult... right?

"Don't touch the cat!" is a mystery, psychological horror game about, well, cats!
And a guy on his first day at work!

[From [url=https://dmeow.itch.io/dont-touch-the-cat]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是阿德里安，这是你第一天上班！

你唯一要做的就是照顾这只猫5分钟，直到她的主人回来！没那么难……对吧？

“别碰猫！”是一款关于猫的悬疑心理恐怖游戏！
还有一个第一天上班的人！

[来自[url=https://dmeow.itch.io/dont-touch-the-cat]itch.io[/url]]
